THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Peanut Butter Cup Cookie Creami

Crumbl’s Peanut Butter Cup Cookie ft. REESE’S, Creami-style (10/10): a PB2 peanut butter ice cream base with zero mix-ins, topped with a 2-ingredient PB2 + sugar-free maple sauce, a crushed standard Reese’s cup, and sugar-free chocolate syrup. About 380 calories and 43g protein for the whole pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME24 hr freeze + 5 min rest + spin
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~380 cal | ~43g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: No mix-in cycle is used for this build; keep the crushed Reese’s cup, PB2-maple sauce, and chocolate syrup on top so every bite has concentrated texture.

Ingredients

BASE

  • 1 cup (240ml) Nurri plain 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1/2 labelled serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate
  • 2 tbsp zero-calorie monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum, levelled
  • Pinch of salt
  • 1 tbsp PB2 Original powdered peanut butter

MIX-IN

  • None (no mix-in cycle; all extras go on top)

TOPPINGS

  • 1 tbsp PB2 Original powdered peanut butter (for peanut-maple sauce)
  • 1 tbsp Maple Grove Farms sugar-free maple-flavor syrup (stirred with the PB2)
  • 1 standard Reese’s milk-chocolate peanut butter cup (~21g), crushed
  • 1/2 tbsp Hershey’s sugar-free chocolate syrup

Allergens: dairy, peanuts, soy.

You want a 10/10 peanut butter cup ice cream pint where all the texture and flavor contrast lives on top—glossy PB2-maple sauce, real crushed Reese’s cup, and chocolate syrup over a 43g-protein pint.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND & FREEZE BASE. Blend 1 cup Nurri plain 2% milk, 1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate, 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener, 1/8 tsp levelled guar gum, a pinch of salt, and 1 tbsp PB2 Original until smooth. Freeze upright on a level surface for 24 hours.
  2. 2.REST & SPIN (NO MIX-INS). Let the frozen pint sit on the counter for about 5 minutes, then process on Regular Ice Cream. Re-spin if needed for a creamy texture without adding extra liquid.
  3. 3.STIR PB2-MAPLE SAUCE. In a small bowl, stir 1 tbsp PB2 Original with 1 tbsp Maple Grove Farms sugar-free maple syrup until it forms a thick, glossy peanut-maple sauce.
  4. 4.SCOOP & TOP. Scoop the peanut butter ice cream into a bowl and top with the PB2-maple sauce, 1 crushed standard Reese’s peanut butter cup, and 1/2 tbsp Hershey’s sugar-free chocolate syrup.

Keys to success

  • Use a level 1/8 teaspoon of guar gum and do not add extra liquid during the Re-spin.
  • Nutrition covers the entire finished pint including both tablespoons of PB2 (1 tbsp in the base + 1 tbsp in the sauce), the standard Reese’s cup, and the syrups.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the unspun PB2 base upright and level for up to 1 week. Stir the PB2-maple sauce and add the crushed Reese’s cup right when serving.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint.

Lasts: Unspun frozen pint keeps 1 week; enjoy immediately after spinning and topping.

Estimated nutrition

~380 cal | ~43g protein per 1 whole finished Creami pint (all toppings included).

Label-based estimate is 383.5 calories and 42.5g protein for the entire finished pint, rounded to ≈380 calories and 43g protein. Breakdown: 1 cup Nurri plain 2% milk (150 cal, 20g protein) + 1/2 serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (60 cal, 14g protein) + 2 tbsp total PB2 Original across base and topping (60 cal, 6g protein) + 1 tbsp Maple Grove Farms sugar-free maple syrup (5 cal, 0g protein) + 1 standard Reese’s peanut butter cup (~21g; 105 cal, 2.5g protein) + 1/2 tbsp Hershey’s sugar-free chocolate syrup (2.5 cal, 0g protein) + guar/sweetener/salt (1 cal).
